 Edited by Shubhanshu Dwivedi / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 12:57 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Digvesh Rathi Lucknow Super Giants spinner Digvesh Rathi has hinted that Nicholas Pooran could take over as the franchise's captain in the Indian Premier League (IPL). While LSG are yet to announce Rishabh Pant 's successor, Rathi named the West Indies batter when asked about the team's new captain. Pant led LSG in the 2025 and 2026 IPL seasons after joining the franchise for Rs 27 crore at the IPL 2025 mega auction. However, he left the team to join Delhi Capitals in a trade deal in June 2026, leaving LSG with the task of finding a new captain. Watch Sitanshu Kotak press conference: On dropping Mohammed Siraj, Ravindra Jadeja, dropped catch and more Pooran is among the frontrunners for the role. He has been part of LSG since 2023 and was retained for Rs 21 crore ahead of the IPL 2025 mega auction. The left-handed wicketkeeper-batter is also the franchise's highest run-scorer in the IPL. Rathi's response has added to speculation about Pooran's appointment. In a video that is going viral on social media, the Delhi-born spinner was asked about LSG's new captain during Delhi's recent match in the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy. He responded by naming Pooran.  Pooran has experience leading teams in T20 cricket. He previously captained the West Indies in T20Is and has also led MI New York in Major League Cricket and MI Emirates in the International League T20 (ILT20). Apart from Pooran, LSG could consider Mitchell Marsh , Aiden Markram , Sam Curran and Josh Inglis for the captaincy role. Marsh and Markram currently lead Australia and South Africa in T20Is, respectively. Curran has captained Punjab Kings in the IPL and also guided Desert Vipers to their maiden ILT20 title in 2026. The England all-rounder joined LSG in a trade deal from Rajasthan Royals ahead of the IPL 2027 retention deadline. Poll Vote & Share your view
